title: The Dark Reality of Sharks Hating Influencers: The Ego Clash Between Anupam and Flying Beast
description:
Click here to explore Odoo - https://www.odoo.com/r/ME6

Why do so many creators feel uncomfortable on Shark Tank India?
Is it just tough love from investors, or is there a deeper clash between traditional business minds and the new creator economy?

In this video, we break down the growing tension between influencers and sharks. From ego clashes to business model criticism, we explore what really happens when internet fame walks into a boardroom full of hardcore investors.

We also discuss real incidents where creators faced strong pushback on the show:

• When Shark Tank India judges questioned influencer-led brands for being “hype-driven” rather than sustainable businesses.
• Cases where creator founders were told their valuation was unrealistic because their business depended too heavily on personal fame.
• Moments where sharks openly doubted whether influencer audiences actually convert into long-term customers.

One of the biggest debates revolves around figures like Gaurav Taneja (Flying Beast) and other creator-entrepreneurs who have built massive communities. Do sharks see them as real business builders or just marketing machines?

This video dives into:

• Influencer brands vs traditional startups
• Why sharks challenge creators more aggressively
• Is there bias against influencers?
• Or are investors simply protecting capital?

Is this an ego battle between old money and new fame?
Or is it just serious business discipline clashing with social media hype?

Watch till the end and decide for yourself.
